name: kiro-chat
description: Chat with the Kiro agent in VS Code: editor tabs, the panel or a terminal chat, with approvals and slash commands, and from your phone.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, workspace values for kiroChat.autopilot, kiroChat.defaultEngine, kiroChat.interactionMode and kiroChat.shareEditorContext are ignored. kiroChat.kiroCliPath is never read from workspace settings.

enumDescriptions: Open the chat as an editor tab (supports VS Code's native file-drop overlay: hold Shift to drop images/files).
Open the chat in the side bar view (the Kiro Chat icon in the Activity Bar, or wherever you've moved it).
kiroChat.openIn.markdownDescription: Where **Open Chat** (`Cmd+Alt+K / Ctrl+Alt+K`, status bar) opens the chat. Each chat tab and the side bar view is its own conversation. The Activity Bar icon always opens the side bar view.

kiroChat.kiroCliPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `kiro-cli` binary. Leave empty to auto-detect (`kiro-cli` on PATH, then `~/.local/bin/kiro-cli`).

kiroChat.defaultEngine.markdownDescription: Agent engine to use. `auto` checks which engine runs on this machine (v3 today) and remembers it. The extension needs v3.

kiroChat.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Model for new sessions. `auto` lets Kiro choose per task. Valid values are listed by `kiro-cli chat --list-models`; you can also switch models live from the chat's model dropdown or `/model`.

kiroChat.interactionMode.markdownDescription: `persistent` uses the long-lived `kiro-cli acp` process (enables tool approvals and multi-turn in one process). `one-shot` spawns a process per turn with `--resume-id` (no live approvals).

kiroChat.autopilot.markdownDescription: When off (default), run in **Supervised** mode: the agent asks for approval before file changes. When on, tools run without confirmation.

kiroChat.shareEditorContext.markdownDescription: Tell the agent which files are open in the editor and which one is active (paths only, files inside the chat's folder only). Off by default.

kiroChat.enterToSend.description: Press Enter to send a message; Shift+Enter inserts a newline. If off, the behavior is reversed.

kiroChat.remote.autoStart.markdownDescription: Start remote access when VS Code starts (otherwise use **Kiro Chat: Start Remote Access**). Machine setting: a workspace cannot turn it on.

kiroChat.remote.permissions.markdownDescription: What a paired remote device may do: `view` the chats, `prompt` (send, steer, stop, answer questions), `approve` (allow or deny a command once).

kiroChat.remote.httpsPort.markdownDescription: The HTTPS port Tailscale uses for remote access (the address is `https://<this Mac>.ts.net:<port>`). Tailscale only allows these three. 8443 leaves 443 to anything you already serve.

kiroChat.remote.port.markdownDescription: Local port for remote access (it only listens on 127.0.0.1). 0 reuses the port of last time when it is free, otherwise picks a free one.
